Central icy-blue glass resonator glows behind a crescent-shaped pierced brass moon grille on outward decorated face. Small navy enamel tuning shapes below, deep brown leather empty shoulder harness. TOP MOVING DEVICE is a distinct double-prong tuning-fork/crescent rotor: two slender symmetrical inward-curving brass antenna prongs create an open arch, one icy-blue glass resonator fixed at each prong tip. Both prongs join one central brass yoke, which connects to ONE central vertical-axis bearing/swivel. Visible brass spindle gap and collar, rotor lifted well above housing and shoulder loops for unobstructed spinning; no braces locking rotor. This backpack has a clearly movable top element designed to visibly rotate when character jumps. Show explicit mechanical central rotary bearing below rotor, just one moving assembly, room for whole top to yaw. Own premium material style from reference, but create a completely new night-radio shape and top tuningfork; do not copy reference's navy curved mast. Iceblue glow restrained, physical glass not flatblue. Speaker/resonator decorative face broad and directly facing camera. Plain leather contact panel on hidden reverse. All parts connected. Complete top resonators and empty harness within generous evenpadding. Input reference is for crafted materials only.
